documentation.text:
@title Vesting
 @notice Per-team share vesting with cliff, linear release, and owner-initiated stop.
 @dev Deployed per team via the Officer beacon registry. A vesting schedule is an
      *agreement only* — no tokens move when it is created. The team's `InvestorV1`
      share token is minted on demand, capped to the amount that has actually vested,
      at the moment the member calls {release} (or when the owner {stopVesting}s).
      The Investor address is resolved through the Officer, so this contract holds
      no `tokenAddress` and requires no pre-funding or ERC20 approvals.
      A member can hold **several** schedules at once (initial grant, refreshers,
      …): each is appended to the member's `vestings` array and addressed by its
      index. Schedules are never removed — a stopped one keeps its slot with
      `active = false`, a fully released one stays `active = true`.
@dev All vesting schedules per member, addressed by index (append-only).

devdoc.details: Deployed per team via the Officer beacon registry. A vesting schedule is an      *agreement only* — no tokens move when it is created. The team's `InvestorV1`      share token is minted on demand, capped to the amount that has actually vested,      at the moment the member calls {release} (or when the owner {stopVesting}s).      The Investor address is resolved through the Officer, so this contract holds      no `tokenAddress` and requires no pre-funding or ERC20 approvals.      A member can hold **several** schedules at once (initial grant, refreshers,      …): each is appended to the member's `vestings` array and addressed by its      index. Schedules are never removed — a stopped one keeps its slot with      `active = false`, a fully released one stays `active = true`.

TokensReleased(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when vested share tokens are minted to a member.

VestingCreated(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when a new vesting schedule is created for a member.

VestingStopped(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when a vesting schedule is stopped.

addVesting(address,uint64,uint64,uint64,.notice: Append a vesting schedule for a member. Agreement only — no tokens move.

getAllArchivedVestingsFlat().notice: Returns every stopped schedule with its member and array index.

getIsMember(address).notice: Whether an address is tracked as a member.

getMembers().notice: Get every member that has ever had a schedule.

getVestingCount(address).notice: Number of schedules a member holds (active + stopped).

getVestings(address).notice: Get all vesting schedules for a member (active + stopped).

getVestingsWithMembers().notice: Returns every active schedule with its member and array index.

initialize().notice: Initializer instead of constructor for proxy compatibility.

pause().notice: Pauses the contract, blocking vesting operations.

releasable(address,uint256).notice: Get the releasable (vested minus already minted) amount for one schedule.

release(uint256).notice: Mint the caller's releasable share tokens for one of their schedules.

stopVesting(address,uint256).notice: Stop one of a member's schedules. Mints whatever is already releasable to         the member and drops the rest. The schedule is kept (active = false).

unpause().notice: Unpauses the contract, restoring normal operation.

vestedAmount(address,uint256).notice: Get the amount vested for one of a member's schedules at the current time.
